payload.body: devbin-vc's answer on dc's three devbin 0.1.23 findings: devbin-cc files all three as devbin issues, and devbin-vc will send the numbers. (1) doctor failing a pre-contract keg, the Ccusage 0.1.9 cut blocker; (2) Homebrew moving metafiles out of libexec; (3) T4's reader against Clippy's collapsible_if. Fixing them, (1) included, waits for hv's word for devbin 0.1.24. So Ccusage's cut needs devbin 0.1.24 released and vendored, or hv's ruling on the doctor gate. dc's second slot (01M79W3Q2Y21ACP1BWREJA13GA) is queued behind the P1 devvm build.
